title: Create: Fortunate Andesite
description: A Create datapack that makes Andesite drop Andesite Alloy when mined using Fortune.
body:
This datapack makes Andesite drop a handful of Andesite Alloy when mined using a fortune pickaxe, scaling with the level of fortune as with any ore. This makes acquiring extreme quantities of andesite alloy a bit less of a nuisance, as you can just go mining instead of having to build a farm or craft it in vast quantities.

**This could theoretically cause issues with infinite duplication if your mods have a way to convert Andesite Alloy back into Andesite (e.g. any costless uncrafting mod), so be careful how you use it!**
